assets.submittedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Game Art Style comparison preview. Style/medium: stylized low-poly 3D game render with deliberately faceted geometry, clean silhouettes, and compact modular forms. Color palette: pine green, turquoise blue, honey wood, clay red, stone gray. Rendering technique: visible polygon facets, flat-shaded surfaces, soft ambient occlusion, no ink outlines and no cel bands. Primary request: a welcoming riverside village map in bright late-morning light. Composition/framing: wide 3:2 top-down three-quarter orthographic view; a broad diagonal dirt path crosses a clear blue river on a small wooden bridge; secondary paths branch toward open frame edges; include a timber workshop, practical gardens, warm stone, compact homes, and generous walkable space. Route hierarchy and landmarks must read at thumbnail size. Variant 3: vary building grouping and bridge approach while preserving the exact subject. Constraints: no people or creatures. No text, letters, numbers, signs with writing, logo, watermark, UI, frame, combat, weapon, horror, gore, ruins, dark fog, childlike anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, franchise imitation, artist imitation, or copyrighted character.
